hashCrosswalk.v4Reason: V4 engine exposes no cross-language canonical state hash; StateInvariants compares object fields and throws. No V4 internal digest is claimed to equal any C# hash.
hashCrosswalk.csharpHash: Mahjong.Domain.TileStateHash encoding v3, 64-bit FNV-1a over the canonical field stream. It is a V5/C# definition, not a V4 digest.
hashCrosswalk.wallCanonicalDigestAlgorithm: SHA-256 over ASCII 'G-003a|<seed>|' followed by the 136 tileIds in slot order joined by ','
hashCrosswalk.csharpHashVerification: C# golden tests verify the C# hash is stable across rebuilding the same map; no C# hash is stored in this V4-generated file because that would be circular.
